import sys,json,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
from compare_time_recovery_expansion import motion,speed_at
from aic_transfuser_lite.data.time_training_cache_v1 import TimeTrainingCacheDataset
from aic_transfuser_lite.evaluation.time_corner_comparison_v1 import replay_observation_pose,world_points
from aic_transfuser_lite.evaluation.time_recovery_comparison_v1 import recorded_pose_for_pp
cache=Path('../datasets/cache/time_recovery_expanded_20260914')
d=TimeTrainingCacheDataset(cache,'validation',verify_hashes=False)
counts=Counter();errors=[];unsupported=[]
for rid in ('codex-time-recovery-pulseleft-r46','codex-time-recovery-pulseright-r47'):
 index,poses,stamps,speeds=motion(cache/'materialized'/rid/'raw')
 for i,row in enumerate(d._anchors):
  if row['run_id']!=rid: continue
  assert d.input_valid[i] and d.xy_mask[i].all()
  obs=replay_observation_pose([poses[k] for k in row['observation_pose_row_ids']],observation_ns=row['observation_ns'],freeze_receipt_ns=row['freeze_ns'])
  for age in (0.,.1,.2):
   current,reason=recorded_pose_for_pp(index,obs,age)
   counts[f'{age}:{reason}']+=1
   if current is None:
    unsupported.append({'anchor_id':row['anchor_id'],'age_s':age,'reason':reason});continue
   speed=speed_at(stamps,speeds,current.stamp_ns)
   assert np.isfinite(speed)
   if age:
    teacher=world_points(d.targets[i],obs)[int(round(age*10))-1]
    delta=float(np.linalg.norm(teacher-[current.x_m,current.y_m]))
    assert delta<1e-5,delta
    errors.append(delta)
result={'counts':dict(counts),'unsupported':unsupported,'teacher_pose_checks':len(errors),'max_teacher_pose_difference_m':max(errors),'new_input_and_all_teacher_points_valid':True}
path=Path('../runs/time_recovery_expanded_training_evidence_20260914/comparison_r2_motion_smoke.json')
with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
